items.headline: Remarks by Commissioner Brunner on the second Annual Migration Management Cycle
items.summary: European Commission Speech Brussels, 06 Nov 2026 Ladies and gentlemen, Today, we are delivering on a core component of the Pact on Migration and Asylum. We are launching the second Annual Migration Management

items.headline: EU seeks nominations for stakeholder group on tokenisation standards in finance
items.summary: EU seeks nominations for stakeholder group on tokenisation standards in finance 09 November 2026 Digital Finance and Innovation The European Central Bank (ECB), together with the European Commission and the European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA), is calling upon wholesale financial industry stakeholders to express their interest in joining the European Tokenisation Standards Group (ETSG).

items.headline: EU emissions continue to fall as clean energy gains ground
items.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 09 Nov 2026 The European Commission has today published the 2026 EU Climate Action Progress Report and Carbon Market Report, showing that EU greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions continue to fall, clean technologies are expanding, and an increasing amount of ETS revenues are available to EU Member States for investments in decarbonisation
